The Centre for Independent Studies has released my Policy Monograph, [Compulsory Super at 20: ‘Libertarian Paternalism’ Without the Libertarianism](http://cis.org.au/images/stories/policy-monographs/pm-132.pdf). Adam Creighton writes up the main points in today’s [Australian](http://www.theaustralian.com.au/national-affairs/time-to-take-axe-to-compulsory-super/story-fn59niix-1226523817607).
